claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord + passive_trigger family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: No species_trait kind exists in UnitRecord. The union covers only spell, class_feature, and mastery. A SpeciesTraitRecord with a passive_trigger mechanics family is the minimum structural addition needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Luck (Halfling) — kind: species_trait; no matching UnitRecord discriminant in types.ts

claude_proposed_widenings.name: d20_outcome_filter (trigger predicate: roll = 1)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The passive_trigger family needs a way to express 'fires when d20 result equals 1'. No surface type currently models a trigger keyed on a specific numeric die outcome. A new trigger predicate variant is required alongside the passive_trigger family.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die
